controls.label: Nutella Plant-Based 350 g
controls.plausibility: Same brand, jar format, and hazelnut-spread product family.
controls.whyNotSame: It is a plant-based 350 g formulation with GTIN 8000500426494, not the photographed conventional 400 g jar with GTIN 3017620422003.

controls.label: Bialetti Moka Express 1-cup
controls.plausibility: Same manufacturer, one-cup capacity, aluminum boiler, and stovetop brewing family.
controls.whyNotSame: The Moka Express has a conventional upper collecting chamber and lid; the photographed Mini Express has an exposed delivery spout and cup platform.

controls.label: Stanley 12-978 10-inch bullnose rabbet plane
controls.plausibility: Stanley calls it a similar currently manufactured rabbet-plane version with two cutter positions, gauge, and fence.
controls.whyNotSame: The distractor is the later 10-inch 12-978 design; the photographed object is the older 8.5-inch No. 78/12-078 duplex rabbet and fillister plane.

controls.label: Raspberry Pi 5
controls.plausibility: Same manufacturer and broadly similar single-board-computer form factor and connector family.
controls.whyNotSame: Pi 5 has a different SoC and board layout, PCIe and fan connectors, rearranged display/camera connectors, and different printed model identity; the photos show Pi 4 Model B.

controls.label: Flewelling faux-perforated-vinyl armchair, circa 1970
controls.plausibility: Same Flewelling maker family, period, perforated shell language, and office-seating context.
controls.whyNotSame: The listing describes a circa-1970 tubular chrome armchair; the photographed 1966 chair uses a pedestal/caster office base and a different shell/base construction.

controls.label: Casio F-91W-3 green-accent variant
controls.plausibility: Same F-91W series, case, module family, resin band, and functions.
controls.whyNotSame: The F-91W-3 is the green-accent variant; the photographed watch has the black/blue/red F-91W-1 face treatment.

controls.label: Rubik's Retro 50th-anniversary cube
controls.plausibility: Same official 3x3 cube topology and classic color-matching purpose.
controls.whyNotSame: The Retro edition has intentionally boxy edges, slower turning, stickers, a gold side, and an anniversary logo; the photographed cube has modern rounded candy-color plastic pieces and no supported Retro details.

controls.label: Nintendo Game Boy Pocket MGB-001
controls.plausibility: Same Nintendo monochrome handheld lineage, controls, cartridge ecosystem, and product name.
controls.whyNotSame: The Pocket is the smaller 1996 MGB-001 revision powered by two AAA batteries; the photographed original is the larger four-AA gray DMG-01.
